transcript.text: How do I actually begin in my situation?
I don't come from money, and an amount
like $1,000 would be genuinely
significant for where I am right now.
Should I seek out investors at this
stage?
>> God, no. The most expensive thing that
you'll ever give away is equity, because
what you're giving away is a percentage
of all your future earnings, forever.
With no idea of how much that's going to
be for present value today. You have the
ability to get $1,000. If you're going
to partner with someone, they need to
have money you don't have, they have to
have skills you don't have, or they have
to have some sort of distribution that
you don't have, and then you're the one
who has the time and the effort. And so,
no. This is where you managing your
lifestyle and how you currently live.
You work the extra shift or you cut back
on your spending, so that you can have
that extra cash to invest in this
business of yours. You need a very small
amount, so if this is meaningful for
you, put some skin in the game,
sacrifice some lifestyle, and go all in
if this is actually really important to
you.
